name: nerd4rent
description: Daily developer workflow automation — bootstrap new projects with git init, README scaffold, GitHub remote via gh, matching Linear project, and routing to a spec-creating skill of choice; write well-specified Linear issues (with checklist or sub-issue decomposition); drive a Linear issue through a status-driven plan-implement-review workflow; mechanically start an issue (branch, empty commit, draft PR/MR with the Fixes magic word) and mechanically close out an issue (commit, push, merge PR/MR on GitHub or GitLab, set Done); resume a project from its last checkpoint on the nerdbrain entity page, verified against git and Linear; bootstrap the CLIs those skills require on a fresh machine.
